svg.text: 24 Aug – 20 Nov 2026 · 89 days in one Schengen stint · 29 stops · trains first · geographic layout (≈ = approximate dates)
Bergen ⇄ Stockholm flown both ways. Tallinn ⇄ Helsinki by ferry. Ljubljana → Padua by bus to Trieste, then train. The Strait of Messina by Blu Jet ferry.
